display_long_description:
I Am Zombie: Survival Apocalypse is an intense VR zombie apocalypse shooter that defines virtual reality survival horror. Step into a collapsing world filled with chaos, fear, and endless zombie hordes. Fight to survive the ultimate apocalyptic outbreak in this action packed VR zombie survival game built for Meta Quest. Experience brutal zombie combat, realistic gun mechanics, and nonstop apocalypse survival in full virtual reality.

Battle through waves of undead enemies with powerful weapons and precision shooting gameplay. Every moment is a fight for your life in a terrifying zombie apocalypse world where danger surrounds you. Choose your challenge: Level Mode, a mission based story through infected cities and ruined landscapes, or Endless Mode, a nonstop VR wave shooter that tests your endurance against infinite hordes.

With immersive VR horror action, dynamic zombie defense, and intense apocalyptic combat, every battle feels real. Reload, aim, and survive as the undead close in. Master weapons, manage resources, and conquer the zombie apocalypse survival challenge.

Designed for fans of horror games,  action shooters, and zombie apocalypse survival, this game delivers adrenaline-charged I Am Zombie gunplay and full-scale virtual reality combat. The apocalypse has begun. The zombies are rising. Fight, survive, and reclaim the world in I Am Zombie: Survival Apocalypse.
